title: District Commission's Obligation Not to Grant Adjournment Without Sufficient Cause

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint against a company in the District Commission. The company requests an adjournment without showing sufficient cause. The consumer objects to the adjournment.
content.outcome: The District Commission must not grant the adjournment, as sufficient cause has not been shown. The Commission must record the reasons for not granting the adjournment in writing.

user_queries: Can the District Commission grant adjournment without sufficient cause?
What are the rules for adjournment in the District Commission?
